svg.aria-label: Postiz scheduler press: an n8n console feeds drafted post cards onto a belt; each card slides under the Postiz press, whose calendar drum holds it on its date until a human pulls the lit APPROVE lever — nothing posts without approval. Approved cards ride the output manifold out to six channel tiles: Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, X and Threads. The numbers are the verified ones: 42,141 GitHub stars, AGPL-3.0, 28+ channels, v2.26.0 Nov 18, 2026, verified n8n node, $39/mo Team for 10 channels, 7-day trial.
svg.text: 42,141 STARS · AGPL-3.0 · 28+ CHANNELS · v2.26.0 · VERIFIED n8n NODE · 0 POSTS WITHOUT APPROVAL
